Subject: INVITE NY OBSERVER 25TH ANNIVERSARY Date: March 7, 2013 7:31:14 AM EST To:
Reply-To Dear Mr. Jeffrey Epstein Jared Kushner, New York's youngest powerhouse publisher, is celebrating the 25th Anniversary of the New York Observer on Thursday, March 14th.
Mayor Michael Bloomberg will be by his side to toast you all.
The Observer is honoring those who have defined and shaped New York since 1987. They are celebrating the cities best, brightest and most influential in culture,media and finance. The salmon pink pages are revered among New York's elite as the preeminent voice on power.
The celebration is going to be one of those quintessential New York nights. We are looking forward to seeing you.
X0X0, Peggy Jared Kushner, Publisher Joseph Meyer, CEO Cory Booker Arthur Carter Georgina Chapman Katie Couric Lauren Santo Domingo Larry Gagosian Mariska Hargitay Carolina Herrera Katie Holmes Woody Johnson Peter Kaplan Comm. Ray Kelly Ken Kurson Matt Lauer Blake Lively Terry Lundgren Peter Martins Cynthia McFadden Sean Parker Ron 0. Perelman Stephen Schwarzman
